tasks.name: Spot and flag a business opportunity
tasks.description: Noticed a chance to win new work or grow a client relationship, and raised it with management with enough detail to act on.

tasks.name: Help resolve a client issue
tasks.description: Helped smooth over a client relationship problem - a scope question, a miscommunication, or an urgent ask that needed a fast response.

tasks.name: Create content for marketing or social media
tasks.description: Wrote, filmed, photographed, or designed something used on the company's social media, website, or marketing materials.

tasks.name: Represent the company at an event
tasks.description: Attended, presented at, or helped organise a conference, industry event, or client function on the company's behalf.

tasks.name: Collect and document client feedback
tasks.description: Gathered feedback from a client - formal or informal - and wrote it up so it could actually inform how we work.

tasks.name: Introduce a potential partner or supplier
tasks.description: Connected the company with a partner, supplier, or university link that could lead to new work or capability.

tasks.name: Explain a company decision to the team
tasks.description: Helped colleagues understand a decision, direction, or change that hadn't been clearly communicated yet.

tasks.name: Share a business or performance update
tasks.description: Passed on information about how the company or a project is performing that helped others do their job better.

tasks.name: Support colleagues through a change
tasks.description: Helped colleagues understand or adjust to an organisational, process, or technical change that affected them.

tasks.name: Propose a way to raise concerns upward
tasks.description: Suggested or helped build a channel or process for staff to raise ideas or concerns.

tasks.name: Fix a misalignment between teams
tasks.description: Noticed two teams, sites, or client accounts working out of step and helped get them aligned.

tasks.name: Check in on a colleague's wellbeing
tasks.description: Noticed someone was struggling and reached out, listened, or connected them with support.

tasks.name: Help resolve a conflict
tasks.description: Helped mediate or de-escalate a disagreement between colleagues.

tasks.name: Organise a team culture activity
tasks.description: Planned or ran something that brought the team together socially or improved how people work together day to day.

tasks.name: Recognise a colleague's contribution
tasks.description: Acknowledged someone's good work - publicly or privately - in a way that wasn't already expected of you.

tasks.name: Suggest and drive a culture improvement
tasks.description: Raised an idea for how the team works together, and helped see it through.

tasks.name: Catch or prevent a quality issue
tasks.description: Caught a quality problem before it reached the client, or proposed a review step that improved delivery quality.

tasks.name: Write or improve an engineering standard
tasks.description: Documented how a type of engineering work should be done, or updated an existing standard.

tasks.name: Capture and share technical knowledge
tasks.description: Wrote up how a problem was solved so others can find and reuse the solution.

tasks.name: Build or improve a prototype
tasks.description: Used prototyping (e.g. 3D printing) to test an idea or solve a problem faster than the alternative.

tasks.name: Help decide a technical approach
tasks.description: Worked up the options for a significant technical decision and helped the team choose.

tasks.name: Flag a cost-saving opportunity
tasks.description: Identified a way to reduce costs or use budget more effectively on a project.

tasks.name: Help track project costs or hours
tasks.description: Did the legwork to reconcile spend, hours, or invoicing on a project when it wasn't expected of you.

tasks.name: Prepare a budget or cost estimate
tasks.description: Put together the numbers for a proposal, project, or internal request.

tasks.name: Help with cash flow or expense tracking
tasks.description: Helped keep tabs on project spend or expenses so it didn't fall on someone else to chase.

tasks.name: Flag a security or compliance risk
tasks.description: Noticed and raised a cybersecurity, data-protection, or compliance issue before it became a problem.

tasks.name: Help write or improve a company policy
tasks.description: Contributed to writing or improving a policy so it's clearer or more practical.

tasks.name: Protect company or client IP
tasks.description: Took care to properly document, protect, or handle intellectual property - ours or a client's.

tasks.name: Raise an ethical concern
tasks.description: Escalated a genuine ethical concern through the right channel.

tasks.name: Mentor another engineer
tasks.description: Had a coaching conversation - technical or career-related - that helped a colleague grow.

tasks.name: Onboard a new engineer
tasks.description: Helped a new hire get set up, learn the ropes, or find their feet in their first weeks.

tasks.name: Deliver training or a knowledge-share session
tasks.description: Ran a session, workshop, or short talk that upskilled colleagues.

tasks.name: Help build a career or skills framework
tasks.description: Contributed to defining career paths, skill levels, or promotion criteria.

tasks.name: Support a performance review or development plan
tasks.description: Helped a colleague prepare for a review or put together a personal development plan.

tasks.name: Track team skills and gaps
tasks.description: Helped identify what skills the team has and where the gaps are.

tasks.name: Support the graduate programme
tasks.description: Mentored, trained, or helped design part of the graduate or junior engineer programme.

tasks.name: Coach someone toward a leadership step
tasks.description: Helped someone moving toward a Team Lead or Lead Engineer role build the skills for it.

tasks.name: Improve a business process
tasks.description: Documented or improved how a piece of work gets done, saving time or reducing errors going forward.

tasks.name: Fix a source of wasted time or effort
tasks.description: Found and fixed something that was quietly wasting the team's time.

tasks.name: Help manage a contractor or supplier issue
tasks.description: Picked up and resolved an issue with a contractor doing internal work.

tasks.name: Coordinate an internal project
tasks.description: Took the lead coordinating a non-billable, internal initiative.

tasks.name: Fix a handoff problem between teams
tasks.description: Noticed and fixed a breakdown in how work passes between internal departments.

tasks.name: Help with IT, network, or equipment issues
tasks.description: Helped resolve an IT, connectivity, or equipment problem for a colleague.

tasks.name: Improve the office or workplace
tasks.description: Proposed or actioned an improvement to the physical workplace, or flagged a safety issue.

tasks.name: Refer or help recruit a candidate
tasks.description: Referred someone for a role, or helped with an interview or hiring process.

tasks.name: Help onboard a new hire
tasks.description: Supported the paperwork or systems-access side of getting someone started.

tasks.name: Contribute honest exit feedback
tasks.description: Shared candid, useful feedback when leaving a role or team, or helped collect it from someone else.

tasks.name: Help improve a People process
tasks.description: Helped improve how recruitment, onboarding, or induction actually works.

tasks.name: Contribute an idea to company strategy
tasks.description: Fed engineer-level insight into a discussion about company goals or direction.

tasks.name: Spot a new market or service opportunity
tasks.description: Identified a potential new market, technology, or service the company could offer.

tasks.name: Help with resource or capacity planning
tasks.description: Contributed insight into where people, time, or budget should be focused.

tasks.name: Support a growth initiative
tasks.description: Helped build something needed to take on more work or more engineers - a process, tool, or template.

tasks.name: Contribute to a sustainability or outreach initiative
tasks.description: Took part in CSR, STEM outreach, or environmental efforts.
